CustomField.description: 30 days from the row's own CreatedDate, set on every appended row for a questionnaire draft (Draft_Type__c = 'Assessment'). Null on Booking rows -- that population has no expiry, by design (see GTM_Form_Draft__c's own description). GtmAssessmentDraftController.resumeDraft treats the most recent row's Expires_At__c as authoritative; it is not extended on save, so a life counted from last touch cannot be kept alive forever.
CustomField.label: Expires At
